summary: Announcement of a two-day course at SRI on using the Network Information Center's online system, including the Journal. It is aimed at station agents and secretaries, with a limit of 12 people.

plainLanguage.summary: The Network Information Center planned a course at SRI on using its online system and Journal. The course was especially intended for people who could help others at their sites.

subtitle: A two-day course on the NIC online system and NLS Journal.

tldr.problem: Network sites needed people who could help colleagues use the Network Information Center's online system.
tldr.mechanism: The NIC planned a two-day course at SRI on using NLS, including its Journal, with particular interest in Station Agents and Secretaries.
tldr.outcome: The course was open to anyone but limited to twelve participants.

today: RFC 276 is a training announcement published in November 1971. The unit metadata lists its status as Unknown.

sections.title: Course Content
sections.content: The Network Information Center planned a course on using its Online System, NLS, including use of the Journal. The course was scheduled for November 29 and 30 at SRI.
sections.plainLanguage: The course would teach participants to use NLS and its Journal. It was planned as a two-day event at SRI.

sections.title: Who Could Attend
sections.content: The NIC particularly wanted Station Agents or Secretaries who could help people at their site use the NIC and transcribe documents or messages into NLS. Anyone was welcome, subject to a limit of 12 participants.
sections.plainLanguage: Station Agents and Secretaries were especially encouraged because they could help other users. Anyone could attend if space was available within the twelve-person limit.

sections.title: Contact and Lodging
sections.content: People interested in attending were asked to contact Dirk Van Nouhuys or Dick Watson at SRI. The NIC offered to make motel reservations and usually used the Mermaid Motel in Menlo Park.
sections.plainLanguage: Interested participants could contact the named SRI staff. The NIC could also help arrange motel rooms.
